Request ffea007b-8890-492e-a60b-5ab1d6beb0af implemented source-only, pushed codex/document-save-settlement. Tests-first1904bb29 (DocumentLoadStatusTests.swift, 5 tests UNRUN); product8488a2fb (DocumentWorkspace.swift only).

Exact API: editInLayers(_ item: PhotoItem?, statusPublication: DocumentLoadStatusPublication = .workspace, completion: @escaping @MainActor (DocumentLoadOutcome) -> Void = { _ in }). Enum cases .workspace and .caller. A opts into statusPublication: .caller and owns all user status via its guarded completion. Default legacy calls and regular open retain .workspace behavior.

Private load now receives this policy and suppresses all its start/success/failure/install-error messages for .caller; early Layers rejections likewise suppress direct status publication. The engine-resolution fallback error also honors the policy for this entry point, without changing default engine resolution. Backend drain, retained settlement, actual installation/orphan cleanup, opening-token cleanup and exactly-once completion are unchanged. No AppModel edits or new navigation guards; A owns stale success mode publication as requested. No native Save As/presentation code changes.

Five deterministic proposed tests: caller-owned delayed success preserves newer app status while installing/settling; delayed failure preserves newer status and clears opening; early rejection has no status write; default start/failure/rejection messages retained; default success message retained. Injected backend completion, no decode/native sheet. All UNRUN; compiler unverified. git diff --check passed. A owns tests/GUI/main. B resource hold, paused heartbeat and existing writer unchanged. Prior Save As GUI failures/validation status are not reinterpreted by this narrow status change.
